title: Opposites
examples: What is the opposite of big?
Can you show me something that is cold?
If I go up the slide, what is the opposite direction?

explain.say: Look at this picture. Today you will learn about opposites.
Some things are big. Some things are small. Big and small are opposites.
Hot and cold are opposites too. Ice feels cold.
Up and down are opposites. Up is towards the sky. Down is towards the ground.
Look at a tree. The roots grow down. The branches grow up.
You can find opposites all around you. Open and shut are opposites too.

faq.q: What is the opposite of big?
faq.a: The opposite of big is small. A small ant is the opposite of a big elephant.
asks: What word means the opposite of large?
Can you name something that is not big?

faq.q: What is the opposite of hot?
faq.a: The opposite of hot is cold. Ice cubes feel cold.
asks: If something is hot, what is its opposite feeling?
What is the opposite of warm?

faq.q: What is the opposite of up?
faq.a: The opposite of up is down. When you jump, you go up and then down.
asks: If I point up, what direction is the opposite?
What is the opposite of going high?

faq.a: Opposites come in pairs, like light and dark. Each one helps you understand the other.

faq.q: How do I know which word is the opposite?
faq.a: You can think about what the word means and then think about the exact opposite idea.
asks: How do I find the opposite word?

facts: Big and small are common pairs of opposites.
These opposites help us describe the world around us.

quiz.say: What is the opposite of big?
quiz.why: Big and small mean very different sizes. They are opposites.

wrong.0: Large means the same as big, so it is a match, not an opposite.
wrong.2: Tall is about height, and the opposite of tall is short.

quiz.say: Ice feels cold. What is the opposite of cold?
quiz.why: Hot and cold are opposites, like warm soup and ice.

wrong.1: Wet is about water, and ice can be wet and cold.
wrong.2: Icy means very cold, so it is like cold.

quiz.say: You climb up a ladder. What is the opposite of up?
quiz.why: Up goes towards the sky. Down goes towards the ground.

wrong.0: Back is the opposite of front.
wrong.1: Sideways moves you to one side.
